remote_identity_source: Operator-confirmed names on 2026-10-27; exact API deployment IDs not stored in predictions

remote_merge.policy: Canonical historical runtime indices; original split identifiers retained in _merge_source. Raw text unchanged, no answer recovery. Missing requests remain missing.

selection.selection: Stratified by ability and interaction, independent of response correctness/timing hits; no requirement of successful probe completion.

metrics.note: Text/reference consistency only. Legacy prompts did not require structured calls; missing positive calls score zero.

metrics.scope: TP only; completion and means apply to this input snapshot, not the full inference run
metrics.note: TP-conditional content scores, not overall benchmark performance. Agent task score=(response+call)/2; missing/invalid calls score zero. No video or future tool results sent.

content_paired.scope: Same (sample_index,response_index), realtime onset matched its reference window and probe post-prefix decision TP; reuse existing independent judgments; no new API calls.
